successors.name: Kingdom of Northumbria
successors.text: 'the Gododdin seem to have come under the rule of Bernicia around this time' (638); Bernicia then became part of Northumbria

ledger.x: The Gododdin, 'Descendants of the Votadini': infobox 'Established: circa 4th century'; Cunedda 'is supposed to have been a Manaw Gododdin warlord who migrated southwest during the 5th century'.
638: Din Eidyn falls to the Angles.

wars.name: Battle of Catraeth
wars.outcome: 'In around 600 the Gododdin raised a force of about 300 men to assault the Angle stronghold of Catraeth'; it 'ended disastrously for the Britons' and is memorialised in the poem Y Gododdin.

wars.name: Siege of Din Eidyn
wars.outcome: Edinburgh 'under siege and fell to the Angles'; Bernicia rules the area afterwards.

certainty.note: The page says the extent is not known exactly.
